stories.title: The one change that worked: I deleted Instagram – and embraced the joys of a truly private life
summary: I self-righteously refused to download TikTok, declared Snapchat to be for “children”, and posted less regularly on Instagram than half of the people I followed.As I went through my university years, however, certain changes crept up on me.
I began to swap reading – or essay-writing – for hours spent curating new posts.
What usually followed was a night of reloading my feed to see how many people had reacted to my post – or worse, hadn’t reacted at all.

stories.title: What are self-replicating ‘AI worms’, and why is Anthropic worried about them?
summary: The red team, as such internal testers are called, said it created a malicious AI program that spread autonomously through internet-connected “smart” televisions and could do the same inside other ordinary devices.

While machines running AI usually need a fair amount of computing power, the researchers said that their program split parts of itself among 15 televisions and was still able to function by using a bit of power from each.
